visual_review.assessment: Six complete human bandit-chief poses preserve beard, headband, black fur shoulders, crimson sash and screen-right curved saber. Selected already-generated gait candidate eliminates the original sheet's five alpha128 outer-edge saber pixels. Knee flex and strides vary, but one leading leg still dominates; true alternating gait remains a residual issue after the one allowed correction.
